definition: A 2.4-meter non-sentient security robot manufactured by Arcturus Defense. Deliberately built below the consciousness threshold. Follows orders without hesitation, doubt, mercy, or personality. The Shelf calls them 'Corporate Furniture.' The synthetic rights movement calls them 'proof that not everything with legs is a person.'
origin: Arcturus Defense Solutions product designation — the street adopted the name because the things are huge and stupid
example: Two Goliaths at the door. Don't bother talking to them. They don't talk back. They don't think. They just stand there until someone tells them to stop standing and start shooting.
